name: artifact-callbacks-channel
description: Channel build of Artifact Callbacks: clicks on HTML pages Claude writes arrive in the running session as channel messages, through the same loopback-only listener

port.title: Port
port.description: Fixed loopback port for the listener (0 picks a random free port each session)

artifactsDir.title: Artifacts folder
artifactsDir.description: Folder the listener serves pages from, relative to the project root

allowFileOrigin.title: Allow file:// pages
allowFileOrigin.description: Accept events from pages opened straight from disk, authenticated by a per-page token

maxPromptChars.title: Max message length
maxPromptChars.description: Cap on the rendered text of one event, in characters
